{{Top|leg}}

The '''holonet entertainment system''' was a system that could be installed aboard pre-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Tython system/Legends|Tythan]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. Such a system was heavy enough to have an impact on the craft's net weight. At some point prior to [[25,793 BBY]], [[Je'daii]] [[Je'daii Ranger|Ranger]] [[Lanoree Brock]] replaced the holonet system on her [[Peacemaker-class cruiser|''Peacemaker''-class cruiser]] with an older [[flatscreen]] which doubled as communications center.<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>

[[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] later, the Republic developed a near-instantaneous trans-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] communications network also called the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]].
